---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
author: "Lizzie"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
connection <- dbConnect(duckdb(), "data/seda_2025.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(connection, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
#| message: false
district_2015 <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, score_2015 = rla_score)
district_2023 <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, score_2023 = rla_score)
score_change <- inner_join(
  district_2015,
  district_2023,
  by = c("district_id", "district_name", "state")
) |>
  mutate(score_change = score_2023 - score_2015) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, score_change) |>
  collect()
dbplyr_state <- tbl(connection, "state_scores")
state_2015 <- dbplyr_state |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, score_2015 = rla_score)
state_2023 <- dbplyr_state |>
  filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, score_2023 = rla_score)
state_change <- inner_join(
  state_2015,
  state_2023,
  by = c("stateabb", "state_name")
) |>
  mutate(score_change = score_2023 - score_2015) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, score_change) |>
  collect()
print(state_change)
```

```{r}
score_change |>
  mutate(
    rla_change = score_change,
    direction = case_when(
      rla_change > 0 ~ "Positive",
      rla_change < 0 ~ "Negative",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rla_change, fill = direction)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Negative" = "#d95f02", "No change" = "gray60", "Positive" = "#1b9e77")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of District Reading Score Changes",
    subtitle = paste("2015 to 2023 across", nrow(score_change), "districts"),
    x = "Change in reading score",
    y = "Number of districts",
    fill = "Change",
    caption = "Positive values indicate improvement; negative values indicate decline."
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| fig-height: 12
plot_connection <- dbConnect(
  duckdb(),
  "data/seda_2025.duckdb",
  read_only = TRUE
)
dbplyr_state_plot <- tbl(plot_connection, "state_scores")
state_plot_data <- inner_join(
  dbplyr_state_plot |>
    filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
    select(stateabb, state_name, score_2015 = rla_score),
  dbplyr_state_plot |>
    filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
    select(stateabb, state_name, score_2023 = rla_score),
  by = c("stateabb", "state_name")
) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(
    direction = if_else(score_2023 >= score_2015, "Improved", "Declined"),
    state_name = fct_reorder(state_name, score_2023)
  )
dbDisconnect(plot_connection, shutdown = TRUE)

ggplot(state_plot_data, aes(y = state_name)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = score_2015, xend = score_2023, yend = state_name, color = direction),
    arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.12, "inches")),
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = score_2015), color = "gray60", size = 1.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Declined" = "#d95f02", "Improved" = "#1b9e77")) +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Scores: 2015 to 2023",
    subtitle = "States sorted by their 2023 reading score",
    x = "Reading score",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Direction",
    caption = "Gray dots mark 2015 scores; arrows point to 2023 scores."
  )
```
